design_review.DRY: Runtime library owns locking/path/fs/identity rules; example and test probe do not duplicate those decisions. Independent Python participant intentionally verifies the same OS protocol without using Rust.
design_review.separation_of_concerns: Process lease never grants domain/company write authority; runtime crate has no SQLite/credentials/network dependencies. Offline legacy enrollment and protected commit/file scope remain separate.
design_review.modularity: Private non-Clone descriptor and stable typed error/identity API; consumers cannot forge a lease or recover a revoked lease using PID/nonce text. Actual future writer API must enforce admission before effects.
